servinfo.title: Inspection of BCM and Its Circuits

servinfosub.title: Voltage and Signal Check
servinfosub.ptxt: Check voltage and/or pulse signal of BCM (1) and J/B (2) using voltmeter (3) and oscilloscope (4).

item.ptxt: Check that battery voltage is 12 V or more.
The voltage of terminal with asterisk (*) cannot be measured by voltmeter because it is pulse signal.
Check it with oscilloscope if necessary.
